rows.note: Use 大楷 as the everyday all-purpose term for an uppercase letter.

example.english: The first letter of your name needs to be a capital letter.
example.traditional: 你個名第一個字要用大楷。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 meng2 dai6 jat1 go3 zi6 jiu3 jung6 daai6 gaai1

rows.note: Use 大寫字母 when you want to be especially explicit or are discussing letters in a more formal or instructional context.

example.english: When filling out official documents, each word in an English name should begin with a capital letter.
example.traditional: 填寫正式文件時，英文姓名嘅每個字都要用大寫字母開頭。
example.jyutping: tin4 se2 zing3 sik1 man4 gin2 si4 jing1 man2 sing3 ming4 ge3 mui5 go3 zi6 dou1 jiu3 jung6 daai6 se2 zi6 mou5 hoi1 tau4
